description: This file defines the FeeSchedule class and related functions for managing fee schedules, including dashboard info, fee creation, and student data retrieval in an ERPNext educational module.

classes.name: FeeSchedule
classes.description: Represents a fee schedule document with methods for dashboard info, validation, and fee creation.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads dashboard info when the fee schedule document is loaded.

methods.name: get_dashboard_info
methods.description: Retrieves total paid, unpaid, and currency info for the fee schedule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the fee schedule, calculating totals and program consistency.

methods.name: calculate_total_and_program
methods.description: Calculates total students, total amount, and checks program consistency.

methods.name: create_fees
methods.description: Initiates creation of fee records, either in background or immediately.
